note: TWO ARMS. The expedition seed exercises target work but produces no social evidence on this world; the shared-range seed exercises both. A four-way identity over a span containing none of the behaviour under audit is an identity claim about nothing, so both arms report what actually occurred in the compared run.

nonVacuity.predicate: the compared daily run must actually contain expedition target work and active parties, or a four-way identity is a claim about nothing

canonicalProjectionIncludes: every expedition's phase, productive workers, non-working members, position and work days
the outcome ring including delivered harvest and party people
the friction ring by event id, interpretation and tension
encounter record count, contact-memory identities, trip record count
expeditionSeed.publicTimeControlNote: the eventual public Day/Season simplification remains DEFERRED and is not implemented; all four internal modes are retained as batch sizes over the same daily kernel.
